images.title: Each name is a thousand times the last
images.purpose: Shows thousand, million, billion and trillion as a staircase where each step multiplies by 1000, and a googol, 10¹⁰⁰, far above.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. One rising staircase of four steps on the left and one tall broken column on the right.
images.exact_structure: A staircase of four equal teal (#0072B2) steps rising left to right, each step the same height, labelled on its top face: thousand 10³, million 10⁶, billion 10⁹, trillion 10¹². An amber (#E69F00) curved arrow over the steps labelled × 1000 each step. To the right, separated by space, one tall reddish purple (#CC79A7) column with a zigzag break line across its middle to show it is not to scale, labelled googol 10¹⁰⁰ at its top. Nothing else.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Each international name is 1000 times the last, so the exponent grows by 3.
images.description: Shows thousand, million, billion and trillion as a staircase where each step multiplies by 1000, and a googol, 10¹⁰⁰, far above.
images.context: 10³ × 10³ = 10 to the power 6, and so on in steps of 3.

image_decisions.why: The staircase makes the steady add 3 to the exponent pattern visible.
